newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai interbank rate firms, baht eases late.
newsitem.headline: Thai interbank rate firms, baht eases late.

text.p: The Thai overnight interbank rate firmed to 8.00-8.50 percent in late trade on Monday from 7.00-7.25 percent in the morning as heavy dollar buying tightened liquidity in the market, dealers said.
"There was relatively strong buying of the dollar in the foreign exchange market this afternoon. This affected the money supply," said one dealer at a local bank.
The demand for the dollar weakened the baht to 25.535-25.540 to the U.S. unit late compared with 25.533-25.536 early, dealers said.
Dealers attributed the heavy demand for dollars to the U.S. unit's continued strength overseas and the relatively low short-term baht interest rates.
The one-month baht/dollar swap premium was quoted at 7.50/8.20 satangs per dollar late against 7.75/8.50 in early morning.
The dollar/baht mid-rate was fixed at 25.51, unchanged from Friday.
